story.title: Gemini Robotics 2 brings whole body intelligence to robots

draft:
Gemini Robotics 2 is pushing the boundaries of robotics with whole body intelligence. 
I'm intrigued by the potential applications of this tech, from search and rescue to healthcare. 
Key features include advanced motor control and sensor integration. 
What real-world problems can be solved with this level of robotic autonomy?
#AI #Robotics #MachineLearning
